descriptionFull: The veery ( Catharus fuscescens ) is a small North American thrush species, a member of a group of closely related and similar species in the genus Catharus , also including the gray-cheeked thrush ( C. minimus ), Bicknell's thrush ( C. bicknelli ), Swainson's thrush ( C. ustulatus ), and Hermit thrush ( C. guttatus ).
